findings.title: sk1000117 - CVE-2026-85102 - Authentication Bypass and Remote Code Execution in Remote Access and Site-to-Site VPN
findings.summary_md: Check Point's advisory for CVE-2026-85102, created September 7, 2026, describes improper validation of certificate data during VPN negotiation that lets an unauthenticated remote attacker execute arbitrary code on a Security Gateway, CVSS 9.8. Affected releases span R81.20, R82 and R82.10 plus end-of-support R80 through R81.10; R82.20 is not affected. The page was later updated to state the vulnerability is actively exploited on Spark Firewalls as of September 12, 2026, and to add a hunt for certificate-based Mobile Access logins using subjects such as CN=vpn, CN=vpn-user and CN=vpnuser with O=global, with fixes in LivePatch Take 26 and Jumbo Hotfix Accumulator Takes 44 (R82.10), 126 (R82), 166 (R81.20) and 190 (R81.10).

findings.title: sk1000118 - CVE-2026-85103 - ASN.1 decoding heap overflow leading to a remote code execution
findings.summary_md: Check Point's companion advisory for CVE-2026-85103, dated September 7, 2026, describes a heap overflow in the VPN certificate ASN.1 decoding flow that may allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Security Gateway. The flaw is rated CVSS 9.8 and is fixed by the same LivePatch Take 26 and Jumbo Hotfix Accumulator takes that cover CVE-2026-85102, since the gateway validation output lists both CVEs against the cpcert, iked and vpn binaries.

findings.title: Cisco Identity Services Engine Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: Cisco's June 25, 2025 advisory covers CVE-2025-20281 and CVE-2025-20282 in ISE and ISE-PIC, both rated CVSS 10.0. CVE-2025-20281 stems from insufficient validation of user-supplied input in a specific API and allows OS-level command execution; CVE-2025-20282 lets crafted files be uploaded into privileged directories through another API. Both were fixed in ISE 3.3 Patch 7 and 3.4 Patch 2 and were reported through Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative.

findings.title: Hackers Start Exploiting Critical Cisco ISE Vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: SecurityWeek reported on July 23, 2025 that Cisco updated the June advisory to confirm attempted in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2025-20281, CVE-2025-20282 and the newly added CVE-2025-20337, all CVSS 10.0 and all yielding root command execution via crafted API requests. The flaws affect ISE and ISE-PIC 3.3 and 3.4, were fixed in 3.3 Patch 7 and 3.4 Patch 2, and all three arrived through the Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative.

findings.title: Max severity Cisco ISE bug allows pre-auth command execution - patch now
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer covered CVE-2025-20337 on July 17, 2025 as a maximum-severity Cisco ISE flaw allowing unauthenticated, pre-authentication command execution. The bug joined the same June 2025 advisory and was fixed in ISE 3.3 Patch 7 and 3.4 Patch 2, marking the previous exploitation cycle for the same product line.
